scope: Four-stage continuation objective and parent checkpoint semantics

objective_contract.fit_endpoint: the exact fit_output/model.pt saved at the configured final epoch
objective_contract.selection_metric: inner-train control weighted Pearson using the frozen control scorer and all_after_warmup AND row_index>=99 mask
objective_contract.descendant_parent_weights: the same fixed-final model.pt whose objective was recomputed

required_artifacts: exact completed fit result and raw config hash
native producer record proving configured-final epoch
auxiliary split SHA256 and exact control membership
ordered control prediction identity, row mask and score inputs
independent recomputation of the frozen control metric
receipt linking the recomputed objective to that exact model.pt

review_notes: Profile engineering admission does not attest full-fit objective execution.
Stage2 initializer and Stage3 teacher ancestry must use the qualified fixed-final model.pt endpoint.
No helper execution evidence was available for this review; do not promote an objective-selection claim until the separate execution receipt is independently checked.
